summary.text: Sammy Jackson is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 28, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican incumbent Bill Partington and Libertarian Joe Hannoush.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Jackson among the withdrawn or disqualified Democratic candidates in the 2024 District 28 race, which John Navarra later contested in the general election.
